# Dwarves
Dwarves are the closest species to humans, most directly differentiated by their much shorter stature. Their affinity to alcohol allows them to metabolise it in a variety of helpful ways, allowing them to heal and fortify their body. This has manifested itself as well with them being sturdier than humans as well.
## Dwarven metabolism Dwarves have a special metabolism, that prefers alcoholic drinks over food. Additionally they also get special effects from some of the alcoholic drinks.
